Eight seeds per recipe from the first screen (44-51); finalists get 16 more seeds (52-67) before any choice.

A child beats its parent only if its primary is lower by more than max(2 x standard error of the difference, 1% of the parent), it is lower in both 2024-25 and 2025-26, and its 2023-24 guard is not worse by more than that margin. Smaller differences are 'level' and are not pursued.
Prefer changes with a mechanism (nowcast, double counting, data, structure) over continuous tuning; no random hyperparameter searches before the structural axes are closed.
An axis is closed after two rounds without a 'better' child. Combinations only of children that were 'better' on their own.
The release candidate is chosen on seed mixtures (each recipe's seeds pooled) of a few recipes, compared with the B7 mixture refit leak-free on the same seeds; mixture weights are equal, never tuned.
